calculation: Mean crime count in the cell over the previous 3 months (t-1..t-3)
justification: Near-repeat / hotspot persistence (Ratcliffe, 2005; Chainey et al., 2008)
shap_role: Smoothed recent level; expected large positive SHAP for chronically busy cells

calculation: Change in count from t-2 to t-1 (lag1 - lag2)
justification: Short-term momentum of the near-repeat process
shap_role: Separates heating-up from cooling-down cells at equal level; signed SHAP shows direction

calculation: Fraction of all prior months the cell was itself a hotspot
shap_role: Distinguishes habitual from occasional hotspots; strongest single correlate of target

calculation: Total crime in the 8 queen-contiguous neighbour cells in t-1
justification: Spatial diffusion of near-repeat risk (Ratcliffe, 2005; Chainey et al., 2008)
shap_role: Quantifies 'neighbourhood pressure'; mappable SHAP shows spillover into a cell

calculation: Count of shop=* per km^2 in the cell
justification: Retail as crime attractor/generator (Zhang et al., 2020)
shap_role: Explains acquisitive-crime risk from land use, not history

calculation: restaurant/cafe/fast_food per km^2 in the cell
shap_role: Attributes risk to footfall-generating land use

justification: Alcohol outlets & violence/public order (Zhang et al., 2020, 2022)
shap_role: Isolates alcohol-related contribution in the explanation

justification: Transit nodes concentrate transient population/mobility (Zhang et al., 2020)

calculation: Total highway length (m) within the cell
justification: Street permeability & offender movement (Zhang et al., 2022)
shap_role: Links accessibility of the street network to opportunity
